searchText: This is one of the area that is on the critical path for stateless ethereum but currently has nobody actively working on it to the best of my knowledge. We have a known "bad but good enough" solution of just bumping gas prices by an arbitrary amount that we determine by some inexact means. It might be a good way to start, by roughly specifying the bad solution and then iterating from there. Either way this will need some focus by a broader group because this topic could be the most contentious since it will break things.
